name: Agent Deep Modeling Tests

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/internal-packages/agent/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/app/api/chat/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/features/sessions/**'
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'frontend/internal-packages/agent/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/app/api/chat/**'
      - 'frontend/apps/app/features/sessions/**'

jobs:
  test-agent-deep-modeling:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [20.x]

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js ${{ matrix.node-version }}
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Agent Deep Modeling Tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="agent" --testNamePattern="deep modeling|workflow setup|timeline sync"
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Run Chat API Integration Tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="api/chat"
        env:
          CI: true

      - name: Run Session Creation Helper Tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern="sessionCreationHelpers"
        env:
          CI: true
